reference: Flight-line repeatability; USGS DTM; Chesapeake 1 m land cover; JRC water; Overture bridges
result: Swaths agree to 3.0 cm (roads) and 3.8 cm (open ground); ground is 4.1 cm from USGS's DTM (bias -3.0 cm); bridge cells are 90% road in Chesapeake; the source-water voids do not match any mapped water
status: Partly validated. Heights and road classes are checked; flood extent, depth and the tide link are not (no gauge, benchmark or observed flood data).

reference: Null test with two independent 2010 surveys; level of detection recalibrated on it
result: The surveys differ by a 32.8 m datum offset; after removing it 47% of coastal cells still read as change with the formula threshold; with the null-calibrated threshold the 2016-2023 net change is -23362 m3 against a null of -2686 m3, and the 2010-2016 net (-3674 m3) is inside the null
status: Validated by null test. The 2010-2016 change is not claimed; the 2016-2023 loss is. No ground survey (GNSS, profiles) was compared.

reference: Repeat lidar survey (2018 against 2022); WorldCover and Esri land cover
result: Cover 60% against 63%, agreement 90% (kappa 0.80); 90% of trees found in both surveys; 2022 minus 2018 canopy height +0.8 m per cell and +1.3 m for matched trees (four years of growth plus noise); WorldCover and Esri call 98% of the window tree against our 60% canopy (their classes include open-grown and sparse stands; precision 100%)
status: Validated against a second survey. No field plots (FIA) were compared.

reference: USGS DTM; WorldCover; Esri land cover
result: Ground 2.6 cm from USGS's DTM; against WorldCover accuracy 71%, kappa 0.44; Esri labels almost the whole suburb built area and none of it trees, so it is not usable as a reference here
status: Validated for terrain; canopy checked against one usable satellite map only. No second survey; no field plots.

reference: Overture footprints and heights; clear-sky upper bound
result: Footprint area overlap 80% / 73% (West U) and 79% / 80% (downtown); heights disagree (West U r = 0.05, bias +4.0 m), cause not resolved; typical-year irradiance is 80% of clear sky
status: Partly validated. No measured roof irradiance or PV output; the height disagreement with Overture is unexplained and is not claimed either way.

reference: NAIP 2011 water mask; NAIP NDVI against a shifted null; USGS DTM
result: Channel mask IoU 0.84 (kappa 0.88); lidar relief and NDVI correlate at -0.10, z = -6.0 against shifts; ground 2.9 cm from USGS's DTM
status: Ridge existence supported, modestly. Migration rates need a second epoch (none exists for this reach in 3DEP); not claimed.

reference: USGS DTM (2013-14 collection); earlier stable-ground and DEM cross-checks
result: 2014 ground 5.2 cm from the USGS DTM (bias -4.6 cm); M3C2 and DEM-of-difference volumes within 5% (docs/coastal-erosion.md)
status: Partly validated. No GNSS or beach-profile data; no USGS DTM exists for the 2021 survey.

result: Main-roof height correlates at r = 0.94 with Overture; Space Needle top 184.5 m against Overture 184 m; large disagreements are listed
status: Two datasets agreeing, not surveyed truth. No USGS DTM exists for this project.

reference: Overture power layer (OpenStreetMap-derived); shifted-data tests (docs/utility-extraction.md, fusion-model.md, span-model.md)
result: Poles: recall 12%, precision 47%; fusion and span models are scored against the map with bootstrap intervals; wire interpolation error 4 cm rms on hidden stretches
status: The map is itself incomplete, so scores are bounds. No field survey of poles or lines.

reference: Published ground class and a morphological filter; Sentinel-2/WorldCover cover maps (docs/hydrology.md, site-selection.md)
result: Ground filter compared with the published class; no stream map exists for the area to check channels against
status: Not validated against independent data. No USGS DTM product for this project.
